in_sanskrit.name: अष्ट
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Hashit is derived from the Sanskrit word अष्ट (aṣṭa), which means 'eight'. This name is commonly used in Hindu culture to represent the eighth child in a family or the eighth day of a ceremony.

in_hindi.name: हषित
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Hashit is derived from the Hindi words हष्ट (haṣṭa) meaning 'eight' and इत (it) which is a suffix meaning 'son of'. Thus, Hashit means 'son of eight' or 'eighth born'.

in_tamil.name: ஹாஷித்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Hashit in Tamil is derived from the words ஹாஷ் (hāṣ) meaning 'eight' and ித் (it) which is a suffix meaning 'son of'. Thus, Hashit means 'son of eight' or 'eighth born'.

in_telugu.name: హేశిత్
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Hashit in Telugu is derived from the words హేశ (hēśa) meaning 'eight' and ిత్ (it) which is a suffix meaning 'son of'. Thus, Hashit means 'son of eight' or 'eighth born'.

in_marathi.name: Hashit
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hashit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Hashit is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'ashva', which means 'horse' or 'vehicle'.
